title: Data Quality Analyst Senior
description:
Estamos procurando uma pessoa de tecnologia de dados experiente e inovador para liderar a estratégia de dados e a execução técnica. Esta função envolve liderar uma equipe de profissionais de dados, discutir arquiteturas de dados robustas e garantir a entrega de soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta qualidade que impulsionam a inteligência de negócios e a eficiência operacional. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES: Liderar e orientar uma equipe de engenheiros de dados, cientistas de dados e analistas de dados, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e de alto desempenho. Discutir a arquitetura geral de dados, incluindo armazenamento de dados, data lakes, processos ETL/ELT e estruturas de governança de dados, considerando a escala ideal e o tempo de lançamento no mercado. Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka). Colaborar com produtos, engenharia, e equipes de negócios para entender os requisitos de dados e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas. Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as plataformas e sistemas de dados. Impulsionar a adoção das melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, modelagem de dados e operações de dados. Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados. Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade. Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados. Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roteiro de dados de longo prazo. REQUISITOS DO CARGO: Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área quantitativa relacionada. Inglês fluente ou avançado;
Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência liderando projetos de dados. Forte proficiência em SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação comumente usada em engenharia de dados (por exemplo, Python, Scala, Java). Ampla experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Azure e Databricks) e seus respectivos serviços de dados. (por exemplo, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka) é altamente desejável. Capacidade comprovada de liderar, orientar e inspirar uma equipe técnica. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, interpessoais e de resolução de problemas. Forte pensamento analítico e uma abordagem baseada em dados para a tomada de decisões.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia. Key Requirements: - Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred) - Bachelor's degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field - Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken) - Excellent communication and organizational skills - Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment What We Offer: - Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month) - Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired - Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months - Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results - Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia - If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided - Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team - Support with relocation and integration in Europe Key Responsibilities: - Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.
- Onboarding & Integration: Organize and execute onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company—whether they are working remotely from Brazil or relocating to Croatia.
- Employee Support: Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions and concerns, providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, and company procedures.
- Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.

- Reporting: Generate regular reports on recruitment, onboarding, and retention metrics, as well as bonus eligibility for hired and retained employees.

Estamos procurando uma pessoa de tecnologia de dados experiente e inovador para liderar a estratégia de dados e a execução técnica. Esta função envolve liderar uma equipe de profissionais de dados, discutir arquiteturas de dados robustas e garantir a entrega de soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta qualidade que impulsionam a inteligência de negócios e a eficiência operacional. Projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados escalonáveis e confiáveis usando tecnologias apropriadas (por exemplo, Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka). Colaborar com produtos, engenharia, e equipes de negócios para entender os requisitos de dados e traduzi-los em soluções técnicas. Garantir a qualidade, integridade e segurança dos dados em todas as plataformas e sistemas de dados. Impulsionar a adoção das melhores práticas em engenharia de dados, modelagem de dados e operações de dados. Avaliar e recomendar novas tecnologias, processos e ferramentas para aprimorar e acelerar nossos componentes e capacidades de dados. Solucionar problemas e resolver problemas complexos relacionados a dados, otimizando o desempenho e a confiabilidade. Manter-se atualizado com as tendências do setor e os avanços em tecnologias e metodologias de dados. Contribuir para o planejamento estratégico de iniciativas de dados e roteiro de dados de longo prazo. REQUISITOS DO CARGO: Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística ou área quantitativa relacionada. Inglês fluente ou avançado;
Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, arquitetura de dados ou função semelhante com foco em dados, com pelo menos 2 anos em capacidade de liderança técnica. Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência liderando projetos de dados. Forte proficiência em SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação comumente usada em engenharia de dados (por exemplo, Python, Scala, Java). Ampla experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (Azure e Databricks) e seus respectivos serviços de dados. (por exemplo, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka) é altamente desejável. Capacidade comprovada de liderar, orientar e inspirar uma equipe técnica. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, interpessoais e de resolução de problemas. Forte pensamento analítico e uma abordagem baseada em dados para a tomada de decisões.

Código da vaga:57457 Sobre a BRQ Digital Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior. Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor. BRQ WAY No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente! - O que procuramos? Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação! Responsabilidades: Experiência em Product Designer para trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo Produto e Desenvolvimento. Seu objetivo será construir, suportar e evoluir o nosso aplicativo. Experiência na identificação e priorização de oportunidades, geração de hipóteses e criação de experimentos para validação. Conhecimento de ferramentas e frameworks para Product Discovery, como OST, personas, jobs to be done, service blueprint. Adoção de uma abordagem de teste e iteração usando insights gerados por dados e métodos de pesquisa de experiência. Experiência na definição e análise de métricas de produto e UX. Conhecimento em mensuração da experiência através de análises de heatmaps, testes A/B ou outros experimentos. Domínio em mapeamento de jornadas de usuário, criação de fluxos de experiência e wireframes. Capacidade de articular e comunicar ideias, conceitos e insights de dados de forma clara. CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.
- O que temos pra te oferecer? Mais do que um plano de carreira! A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares: Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos! Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos. Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede. Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.
- E os benefícios? Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais! - Como é trabalhar na BRQ? Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Sourcer Pleno

Experiência com buscasbooleanas ;

title: Talent Matcher - Non Code
description: About the Role We are seeking an experienced Talent Manager to lead end-to-end recruitment delivery for customer-side non-technical roles at Turing. This role focuses on high-volume talent sourcing, capacity planning, and fulfillment across multiple client requirements in a fast-paced, remote environment. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end hiring for multiple customer-side non-technical roles (3–4 concurrent requirements). Serve as the primary point of contact between Delivery and Talent Fulfillment teams. Assess talent supply, identify gaps, and activate external sourcing channels as needed. Oversee capacity planning and hiring ramp-ups to meet client timelines. Partner with Delivery Leads to align on requirements and expectations. Track and report key hiring metrics, ensuring data accuracy and visibility. Qualifications & Experience 5–10 years of experience in recruitment delivery, talent operations, or global staffing. Strong expertise in high-volume sourcing, pipeline management, and onboarding. Experience with client-side hiring models and stakeholder management. Data-driven, highly organized, and comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment. Proficiency with Google Workspace tools (Sheets, Docs, Drive). Preferred Experience Data Annotation or marketplace-based hiring experience, including high-volume talent sourcing and onboarding. Exposure to capacity planning tools or hiring dashboards. Experience in high-growth or startup environments. Soft Skills Strong stakeholder communication and collaboration skills. Analytical mindset with attention to detail. Adaptability — thrives in ambiguity and rapidly changing environments. Proactive problem solver with a focus on ownership over hierarchy. Comfortable handling multiple priorities and working under tight timelines. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is a hands-on operator who thrives at the intersection of talent fulfilment, data-driven decision-making, and stakeholder management. They should be proactive, outcome-oriented, and capable of maintaining operational excellence in a remote-first, high-speed environment.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia. Key Requirements: - Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred) - Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field - Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken) - Excellent communication and organizational skills - Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment What We Offer: - Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month) - Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired - Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months - Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results - Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia - If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided - Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team - Support with relocation and integration in Europe Key Responsibilities: - Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.
- Onboarding & Integration: Organize and execute onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company—whether they are working remotely from Brazil or relocating to Croatia.
- Employee Support: Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions and concerns, providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, and company procedures.
- Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.
- Performance Tracking: Monitor employee performance and retention, provide regular feedback to management, and support the implementation of performance improvement plans.
- Retention & Engagement: Develop and implement strategies to improve employee satisfaction and retention, including organizing team-building activities and wellness initiatives.
- Relocation Assistance: For employees relocating to Croatia, provide support with visa applications, travel arrangements, and settling into their new environment, including coordinating housing (paid apartment provided).
- Collaboration: Work closely with management and other departments to understand staffing needs and contribute to the development of HR policies and best practices.
- Reporting: Generate regular reports on recruitment, onboarding, and retention metrics, as well as bonus eligibility for hired and retained employees.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia. Key Requirements: - Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred) - Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field - Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken) - Excellent communication and organizational skills - Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment What We Offer: - Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month) - Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired - Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months - Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results - Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia - If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided - Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team - Support with relocation and integration in Europe Key Responsibilities: - Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.

title: Analista Adm - Secretaria De Vendas
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Responsabilidades e atribuições Fazer a gestão de toda a equipe de Operações, Segurança e Experiência do Consumidor do shopping;
Maximizar a gestão doorçamento condominial, do resultado financeiro do estacionamento e dos investimentos em CAPEX orçados pelos empreendedores, através do acompanhamento e aprovação dos gastos;
Garantir o cumprimento das políticas e procedimentos padrões da Cia através do monitoramento da rotina de execução dos coordenadores e equipes, acompanhamentos os dos resultados obtidos e análise dos PDCA’s para as melhorias;
Promover a integraçãoe sinergia entre a área de operações e as demais áreas da administração (comercial, marketing e financeiro) na busca por melhores práticas e resultados para o shopping através da intensificação a comunicação e relacionamento das partes sempre que possível;
Realizar a gestão do relacionamento com a área técnica/ engenharia dos empreendedores para análise e aprovação de projetos e obras de melhorias do empreendimento através de realização da um comitê periódico com as partes;
Promover o melhor e mais constante relacionamento com os órgãos públicos de fiscalização e controle de empreendimentos comerciais (prefeitura, governo do estado, secretarias, bombeiros, polícias, etc.), por meio de contato constante e identificação de possibilidades de parcerias (doações de mobiliário, obras no entorno, etc);
Realizar investimentos na infraestrutura do shopping e cobrar a eficiência na execução dos serviços de facilidades bem como da otimização do consumo das utilidades, para redução do risco técnico e operacional do empreendimento, por meio do monitoramento dos prestadores de serviços e concessionárias públicas (água, gás, energia) e na busca por novas soluções tecnológicas;
Controlar asdocumentações legais e licenças de responsabilidade da área de operações para eliminar riscos jurídicos ao empreendimento, através do acompanhamento das datas de vigência das documentações pertinentes e interação com a área jurídica no cumprimento do DOS;
Melhorar continuamente o relacionamento com lojistas e clientes do shopping por meio de atuação preventiva e corretiva as necessidades operacionais destes (manutenção, carga e descarga, acessos fora do horário, etc.) e resposta rápida e satisfatória as solicitações e reclamações apresentadas por eles. Requisitos e qualificações Superior completo em: Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Civil, Engenharia Mecânica ou áreas afins;
Desejável pós graduação;
Experiência com gestão de equipe;
Experiência com manutenção, qualidade e obra;
Imprescindível experiência sólida na cadeira. O Que Temos Para Você

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia. Key Requirements: - Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred) - Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field - Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken) - Excellent communication and organizational skills - Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment What We Offer: - Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month) - Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired - Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months - Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results - Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia - If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided - Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team - Support with relocation and integration in Europe Key Responsibilities: - Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.
- Onboarding & Integration: Organize and execute onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company—whether they are working remotely from Brazil or relocating to Croatia.
- Employee Support: Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions and concerns, providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, and company procedures.
- Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.
- Performance Tracking: Monitor employee performance and retention, provide regular feedback to management, and support the implementation of performance improvement plans.
- Retention & Engagement: Develop and implement strategies to improve employee satisfaction and retention, including organizing team-building activities and wellness initiatives.
- Relocation Assistance: For employees relocating to Croatia, provide support with visa applications, travel arrangements, and settling into their new environment, including coordinating housing (paid apartment provided).
- Collaboration: Work closely with management and other departments to understand staffing needs and contribute to the development of HR policies and best practices.
- Reporting: Generate regular reports on recruitment, onboarding, and retention metrics, as well as bonus eligibility for hired and retained employees.

description: Sobre a vaga Mobiis Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região) Região Sul Sobre a vaga Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter, foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos, para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil. Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia, levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala, com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços. Missão da função Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico. Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação. Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais. Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível. Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE). Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria. Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis. Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços. Negociação e fechamento Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis. Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita. Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento. Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados. Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional. Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial. Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais. Metas e indicadores (referência) Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços). Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas. Taxa de conversão e ticket médio. Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline. Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região. Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter). Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado. Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores. Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados. Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão. Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais. Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades. Diferenciais (alto peso) Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como: TMS (Transportation Management System) WMS (Warehouse Management System) DMS (Delivery Management System) YMS (Yard Management System) Roteirização e otimização logística Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores. Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR). Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço). Exclusividade e conflito de interesses Não há exigência de exclusividade. O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis. Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis. Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades. Modelo de remuneração Modelo comissionado, com comissões atrativas sobre: Receita recorrente (MRR) Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial) Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos. Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial. Suporte da Mobiis Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento. Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas. Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas. Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Product Design
description:

Domínio em mapeamento de jornadas de usuário, criação de fluxos de experiência e wireframes. Capacidade de articular e comunicar ideias, conceitos e insights de dados de forma clara. title: Analytics Architect

description: The Role We are Appointwise. We build high-end AI infrastructure that replaces manual sales teams with autonomous digital workforces. You are\ "Inbox Zero\" Obsessed: You hate leaving problems unsolved. You are proactive, fast, and thorough. Requirements Proven experience building complex automations (Portfolio or examples required). Deep understanding of LLMs (Prompt engineering, Context windows, System prompts). Excellent written and verbal English (Native or C2 level). Been in a previous customer facing technical support roles Ability to work US/EST hours. How to Apply We do not just want a cover letter. Record a short Loom video (max 3 minutes). Tell us about the most complex automation you have ever built and your previous support roles. Explain how it worked and why you built it. Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? Key Requirements: - Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred) - Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field - Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken) - Excellent communication and organizational skills - Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment What We Offer: - Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month) - Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired - Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months - Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results - Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia - If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided - Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team - Support with relocation and integration in Europe Key Responsibilities: - Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.

- Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.

Código da vaga:57457 Sobre a BRQ Digital Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior. Temos 3 mil funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor. BRQ WAY No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente! - O que procuramos? Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação! Responsabilidades: Experiência em Product Designer para trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo Produto e Desenvolvimento. Seu objetivo será construir, suportar e evoluir o nosso aplicativo. Experiência na identificação e priorização de oportunidades, geração de hipóteses e criação de experimentos para validação. Conhecimento de ferramentas e frameworks para Product Discovery, como OST, personas, jobs to be done, service blueprint. Adoção de uma abordagem de teste e iteração usando insights gerados por dados e métodos de pesquisa de experiência. Experiência na definição e análise de métricas de produto e UX. Conhecimento em mensuração da experiência através de análises de heatmaps, testes A/B ou outros experimentos. Domínio em mapeamento de jornadas de usuário, criação de fluxos de experiência e wireframes. Capacidade de articular e comunicar ideias, conceitos e insights de dados de forma clara. CLT, salário a combinar + benefícios.
- O que temos pra te oferecer? Mais do que um plano de carreira! A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares: Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos! Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos. Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede. Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.
- E os benefícios? Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais! - Como é trabalhar na BRQ? Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description: Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS). title: M&A Advisor
description:
Expanda sua Prática de M&A: Una-se à Rede Internacional da ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Conecte sua expertise ao mercado global. Transforme sua assessoria local em uma potência internacional. A ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida assessores de M&A e boutiques independentes de renome no Brasil a integrarem nossa rede global. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta, colaboração internacional e um back office completo para potencializar sua originação e execução de deals no middle-market. Quem Somos Somos uma rede internacional de investment banking especializada em assessoria de M&A para o middle-market. Conectamos mais de 150 assessores em mais de 80 cidades ao redor do mundo, com foco em transações cross-border. Nota Importante: Esta é uma oportunidade de Membership (Afiliação) para profissionais e firmas independentes;
não se trata de uma vaga de emprego (CLT) ou prestação de serviços terceirizados. Ferramentas e Suporte de Classe Mundial Ao longo de duas décadas, a ONEtoONE investiu no desenvolvimento de ferramentas exclusivas que permitem aos nossos membros: Originação de Elite: Conquiste mais e melhores mandatos. Inteligência de Mercado: Identifique compradores ou targets ideais globalmente. Back Office Dedicado: Suporte em todas as fases — desde o pitch e análise financeira até a documentação e busca de contrapartes. Dados Premium: Acesso a perfis de mais de 450 milhões de empresas e dados de transações globais. Colaboração Sem Fronteiras No Brasil, o relacionamento é a base de tudo. Nossa rede permite que você colabore com especialistas em diversos setores e países sem restrições geográficas ou setoriais. Você terá a liberdade de operar globalmente, utilizando ferramentas de IA e bancos de dados proprietários para multiplicar seu alcance e sua receita. Perfil Ideal Buscamos profissionais brasileiros com o seguinte perfil: Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em Corporate Finance, Private Equity, M&A ou assessoria transacional. Idiomas: Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para colaboração internacional). Mindset: Perfil empreendedor, proativo e orientado a resultados. Expertise: Forte rede de relacionamentos local e capacidade analítica. Visão: Desejo de portar uma marca global de investment banking e trabalhar de forma colaborativa. O Que Você Ganha Suporte Full Back Office: Originadores, analistas e especialistas em marketing, jurídico e TI à sua disposição. Tecnologia de Ponta: Acesso às melhores bases de dados de M&A do mundo e ferramentas de IA exclusivas. Networking Global: Conexão direta com pares em 80+ cidades e especialistas setoriais. Transparência: Estrutura de fee-sharing clara que valoriza o trabalho em equipe. Liberdade: Autonomia total para gerir seu negócio com o suporte de uma marca global. Pronto para elevar o nível da sua assessoria? Se você tem a experiência e a motivação para expandir sua prática de M&A para além das fronteiras brasileiras, convidamos você a se candidatar para a rede ONEtoONE International .

Atuamos em diferentes formatos como Atacadão, Carrefour Varejo, Sam’s Club, Banco Carrefour e Carrefour Property oferecendo soluções diversificadas para um Brasil tão plural. Com 130 mil colaboradores, temos o propósito de oferecer alimentação acessível e de qualidade a todos, enquanto contribuímos para uma sociedade mais inclusiva e sustentável.No Carrefour, trabalhamos diariamente a cultura do respeito e da equidade. Se identificou? title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia. Key Requirements: - Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred) - Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field - Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken) - Excellent communication and organizational skills - Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment What We Offer: - Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month) - Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired - Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months - Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results - Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia - If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided - Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team - Support with relocation and integration in Europe Key Responsibilities: - Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.
- Onboarding & Integration: Organize and execute onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company—whether they are working remotely from Brazil or relocating to Croatia.
- Employee Support: Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions and concerns, providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, and company procedures.
- Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.
- Performance Tracking: Monitor employee performance and retention, provide regular feedback to management, and support the implementation of performance improvement plans.
- Retention & Engagement: Develop and implement strategies to improve employee satisfaction and retention, including organizing team-building activities and wellness initiatives.
- Relocation Assistance: For employees relocating to Croatia, provide support with visa applications, travel arrangements, and settling into their new environment, including coordinating housing (paid apartment provided).
- Collaboration: Work closely with management and other departments to understand staffing needs and contribute to the development of HR policies and best practices.
- Reporting: Generate regular reports on recruitment, onboarding, and retention metrics, as well as bonus eligibility for hired and retained employees.

title: Cloud Engineer
description: Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer Location:- Remote (Brazil) The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience. The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards. Key Responsibilities Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development. Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams. Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation. Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure. Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery. Required Qualifications BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field 3+ years of relevant technology experience 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience. Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure. Strong background in software engineering Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting Experience in developing Azure Policies. Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting. Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively. Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others Strong verbal and writing skills Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter Desired Qualifications Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure Skills Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle Level)
description:
About the Job TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S.
-Based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel. Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization. Joining our team you will be focusing on Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings. Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams. Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues. Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs. Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams. Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region. Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc. Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date. Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment. Required Skills A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus Client-facing experience Advanced level of English Great interpersonal and influencing skills Strong verbal and written communication skills Experience with HRIS Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized Attention to detail and high level of accuracy Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload Personal competencies Growth Mindset Proactive and enthusiastic Initiative and creativity Achievement drive and optimism Interpersonal and Communication Skills Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills Why You Should Work at TurnKey We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule Provided laptop (MacBooks) Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget Private health & dental insurance Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year Fully Remote work Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Líder De Produção
description: Descrição da Empresa Prazer, somos a FHOM Alimentos Saudáveis, uma empresa familiar, com 30 anos de mercado fabricando alimentos puros e saudáveis. Para quem ainda não sabe, o nome FHOM tem origem nas primeiras letras do nome do casal fundador e seus filhos. Estamos presentes em todos os estados brasileiros, em mais de 10 mil pontos de venda, alcançando cada vez mais destaque nos segmentos de snacks saudáveis, orgânicos e FREE FROM. Temos como base de trabalho 3 grandes frentes onde nos baseamos para todas as decisões, são elas: QUALIDADE | PESSOAS | INOVAÇÃO Atualmente o parque industrial tem 8.000m2 e 70 colaboradores diretos e mais de 100 indiretos. Os produtos da FHOM são reconhecidos pela alta qualidade e sabores deliciosos de seus produtos. A FHOM prima por utilizar apenas ingredientes naturais e sem nenhum aditivo químico, comprados em sua maioria de pequenos produtores orgânicos e convencionais e tratados como se fossem da família. Todo nosso processo é certificado por auditorias onde temos uma fabricação extremamente sofisticada porém, sem deixar de ser um produto artesanal. Atualmente possuímos os selos SVB, Orgânico, e Kosher. Acreditamos e trabalhamos para que todos os envolvidos, desde o produtor rural até o consumidor final dos nossos produtos, estejam felizes e satisfeitos. Assim, teremos certeza de que realizamos nossa tarefa da melhor maneira possível e que ela valeu a pena. Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Líder de Produção para integrar nossa equipe em São Bernardo do Campo, SP. Este cargo envolve a supervisão das operações diárias de produção, garantindo a eficiência e a qualidade dos processos. As responsabilidades incluem planejamento e gerenciamento da produção, controle de qualidade e treinamento da equipe. Tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas, avaliando trade-offs entre diferentes abordagens e tecnologias. Colaborar na definição da visão de produto de longo prazo do ponto de vista técnico. Realizar revisões de código (code reviews) e de arquitetura, assegurando qualidade, segurança e aderência aos padrões. Resolver blockers técnicos complexos e otimizar o desempenho de aplicações. Contribuir para processos de recrutamento, incluindo entrevistas técnicas e avaliação de desafios de código. Inovação e Melhoria Contínua: Pesquisar, avaliar e propor a adoção de novas tecnologias, ferramentas e frameworks que possam trazer benefícios para os produtos e a produtividade da equipe. Promover uma cultura de DevOps, observabilidade (monitoramento, logging, tracing) e resiliência de sistemas. Liderar ou participar de iniciativas de modernização de legado e refinamento da dívida técnica. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER: Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. Experiência: Mínimo de 7 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com pelo menos 2 anos atuando em uma posição de liderança, técnica, arquiteto(a) de software ou tech lead. Domínio de uma ou mais linguagens de backend (ex: Java) e frontend (ex: JavaScript, React e Angular). Experiência profunda com design de APIs (REST, GraphQL), bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais, mensageria e cache. Conhecimento em arquiteturas de software modernas (microsserviços, serverless, etc.). Prática com ambientes cloud e infraestrutura como código. Vivência com práticas ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban) e ferramentas (Git, JIRA). Excelente capacidade de comunicação, para dialogar tanto com times técnicos quanto com áreas de negócio. Habilidades de mentoria e facilitação para guiar equipes em direção a um objetivo comum. Pensamento crítico e analítico para solução de problemas complexos. Proatividade, autonomia e capacidade de tomar decisões bem fundamentadas. Mentalidade de dono (ownership) e foco na entrega de valor. DIFERENCIAIS: ● Experiência em ambientes de alta escala (high-scale/ high-load). ● Certificações em Cloud ou Arquitetura de Software. ● Conhecimento em práticas de Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) ou FinOps. title: Agente De Suporte De Ti
description:
Prazer, Grupo SBF Para nós, esporte é mais que só a prática: é movimento. Ele tem o poder de mover as pessoas pelo exercício, pela paixão pelo time do coração, pela diversão de uma aula de dança, pela força de marcas icônicas. Por vermos a potência do esporte em todas as suas expressões, trabalhamos juntos com garra e energia para construir o primeiro ecossistema de esporte do mundo, reunindo diversas possibilidades para que as pessoas sejam envolvidas e impactadas pelo poder de se movimentar. Quando você pensar em esporte, pode ter certeza: o Grupo SBF estará ali. Seja por meio das lojas e do e-commerce da Centauro, a maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina;
da Fisia, distribuidoraoficial da Nike no Brasil, da FitDance e da OneFan, aqui o movimento não para. Praticante ou entusiasta, fã ou apaixonado: o Grupo SBF é pra você. Responsabilidades e atribuições: Garantir um atendimento cortês, empático e eficiente, mantendo o foco na resolução rápida do problema. Ser o primeiro ponto de contato (via telefone, e-mail, chat ou sistema de chamados) para solicitações de suporte dos usuários internos e/ou externos. Abrir, registrar, categorizar e priorizar todos os chamados no sistema de gestão de serviços (ITSM). Realizar o diagnóstico inicial e a solução de problemas de TI (Troubleshooting) de Nível I;
Escalonamento: Encaminhar incidentes que não puderam ser resolvidos no Nível I para as equipes de suporte de Nível II ou III (Infraestrutura, Redes, Sistemas), garantindo que todas as informações relevantes sejam transferidas. Acompanhar o status dos chamados escalonados até sua resolução final. Documentar detalhadamente todos os passos de diagnóstico e as soluções aplicadas para cada chamado. Contribuir ativamente para a criação e atualização da Base de Conhecimento (KEDB), FAQs e manuais de autoatendimento para os usuários. Realizar a instalação, configuração e manutenção básica de softwares e hardwares (estação de trabalho, notebooks). title: Quality Assurance Specialist
description: ZTE Is looking for Delivery Engineer (Quality & Safety by Design) Role Overview We are hiring a Delivery Engineer to act as the engineering reference for post-sales delivery execution in complex telecommunications infrastructure projects. This is a hands-on, operational role, focused on engineering decision-making, delivery feasibility, execution quality, and safety embedded by design. It is not a people-management role and not a pre-sales position. The mission is to ensure that what was sold can be installed, integrated, commissioned, accepted, and operated successfully in real environments, right the first time. Key Responsibilities Validate, review, and approve provisional and definitive engineering designs (PPI, TSSR, PDI, FAM, As-Built), ensuring technical consistency across the full delivery lifecycle. Ensure delivery designs comply with customer engineering standards, contractual technical scope, vendor global guidelines, and real site constraints (space, power, grounding, access, structural conditions). Act as the engineering reference for delivery feasibility, identifying gaps, risks, or assumptions that could impact execution, quality, cost, or schedule. Define, validate, and approve the Engineering / Installation Bill of Materials (E-BOM), ensuring completeness and technical adequacy for installation, integration, and commissioning activities. Classify materials and requirements clearly as included, assumptions, or out-of-scope / change-required, supporting transparent scope control. Validate the engineering quality of executed installations, ensuring alignment with approved designs, customer standards, and best engineering practices. Review and approve installation quality and acceptance evidence, including photos, checklists, test results, quality reports, and as-built documentation. Decide, from an engineering standpoint, on installation acceptance, required corrections, or rework, based on objective technical criteria. Embed quality and safety as engineering premises ( quality & safety by design ), ensuring designs and E-BOMs support safe and reliable execution. Identify delivery, integration, and acceptance risks early, proposing engineering mitigations to prevent rework, delays, and SLA impact. Act as the engineering focal point in customer design reviews, technical workshops, and acceptance discussions, representing delivery engineering interests. Interface with HSE/EHS, Quality, PMO, Billing, Presales and Field teams from an engineering perspective, translating requirements into executable design and delivery decisions. Support technical clarification, deviation analysis, and root-cause discussions related to delivery execution and installation quality. This role does not perform field supervision and does not assume legal HSE responsibilities. What This Role Is Not Not pre-sales or solution definition Not people management Not field supervision or safety technician This role drives engineering decisions, not day-to-day execution control. Profile & Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electrical, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or equivalent. Minimum of 5 years of experience in telecommunications delivery engineering within vendor, operator, or system integrator environments. Practical exposure to one or more domains: RAN, IP, Microwave, Optical, DCN. Strong understanding of installation, integration, commissioning, and real-world execution constraints. Postgraduate specialization in Occupational Safety, Risk Management, Quality, or Compliance Working knowledge of Brazilian Regulatory Standards (NRs) relevant to telecom infrastructure projects, such as NR-1, NR-6, NR-7, NR-10, and NR-35. Familiarity with occupational safety procedures and documentation (e.G., basic understanding of PT/APR concepts), from an engineering and feasibility perspective. English – Mandatory (primary working language) Portuguese – Fluent or Native Mandarin – Desirable Why This Role Matters Because delivery success depends on engineering decisions made before problems reach the field. This role ensures that: delivery designs are executable in practice, quality is built into engineering decisions, safety is considered by design, customer acceptance is predictable and auditable. If you see yourself in this position and would like to become a part of ZTE group, please apply sending you resume in English version. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Facility Manager
description:
Americas Cluster Operations Team We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. We are dedicated to delivering "last mile customer value" from our operational facilities, providing a seamless, reliable, and highly efficient service experience. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning: Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization. IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects. Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies. Our Core Focuses: End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity. Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs. Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices. We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration. Job Responsibilities: 1. Responsible for the daily operation and maintenance management of large-scale operational facilities within the responsible region, ensuring the efficient, stable, and compliant operation of their critical physical support systems (e.G., power, HVAC, fire suppression). 2. Develop and implement facility operation strategies, procedures, and emergency plans, ensuring facility operations comply with internal standards and external regulations. 3. Manage the facility operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and daily supervision, to enhance team professionalism and cohesion. 4. Lead facility capacity planning, energy efficiency management, and optimization projects, promoting sustainable operation practices and reducing operational costs. 5. Manage facility-related vendors and service providers, ensuring service quality and SLA compliance. 6. Lead or participate in root cause analysis for facility incidents, and the development and implementation of corrective actions. 7. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.G., IT, Security, Business Units) to ensure facility operations effectively support overall business objectives. Job Requirements: 1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Automation, or a related engineering discipline. 2. Over 8 years of experience in large-scale facility operation and maintenance, with at least 3 years in a management role;
experience in multinational corporations preferred. 3. Familiar with the operational principles, maintenance, and troubleshooting of critical physical support systems. 4. Proven team leadership and project management skills, capable of effectively driving complex project implementation. 5. Familiar with relevant safety regulations, industry standards, and environmental compliance. 6. Strong communication and coordination skills, problem-solving abilities, and risk management awareness. 7. Fluent in English, able to communicate effectively as a working language. 8. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications (e.G., PMP, CFM) are a plus. 9. (Plus) Familiarity with energy efficiency management and green operation practices is a plus.

By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience. As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices. TECHNICAL SUPPORT TEAM Technical Support is at the center of everything that happens with Playtech’s software solutions. Our work is constantly evolving as we provide support across the entire range of Playtech products and this brings unique challenges, but also ensures our work stays dynamic and exciting. A Technical Account Manager (TAM) is the keeper of the availability and technical integrity of Playtech services offered to our VIP customers (licensees). Job Description Your influential mission. You will... Maintain full awareness and visibility of licensee technical support and operational activities throughout the service lifecycle Ensure correct prioritization, overseeing the handling and efficient resolution of all licensee issues Act as the main focal point between the licensee organization and Playtech's internal divisions in all technical aspects of service delivery Align Playtech operational procedures with their counterparts in the licensee organization, identifying support optimization opportunities and leading service improvement programs Gain a complete understanding and maintain an up-to-date overview of licensee services, logical setup of solutions, and 3rd party integrations Act as a licensee knowledge centre within Playtech Qualifications Components for success. You... Are an excellent communicator with proficiency in spoken and written English Have experience in IT field in support and/or account management role. Client-facing skills Possess strong problem-solving skills with the ability to maintain progress in stressful work situations Excel at juggling multiple demands and prioritizing work according to defined goals Are well organized and self-managed and strive continuously to improve your work efficiency Have knowledge and experience with modern IT solutions and IT Services Management (ITIL, Lean IT, DevOps). Able to act in change and quickly react to unexpected situations. Additional Information Thrive in a culture that values... A supportive and collaborative team environment. Opportunities for professional growth and development. A commitment to innovation and excellence. A diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is welcome. Comprehensive benefits and competitive compensation. HOW TO APPLY? Please upload your up to date resume in English and add a brief motivation letter covering your goals and your current experience. You can write it in the comment section at the end of the application page (under "your message to the hiring manager").

title: Business Leaders (Paid Consultancy Opportunity)
description: Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS). About - We are looking to speak with leaders and senior professionals —such as CEO, CFO, Director, VP, Department Head and Senior Manager. Qualifications: The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part. Job titles: C-suite Executive, Partner, Director, Vice President, Head of Department and Senior Manager. Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you. Compensation package - BRL 790 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Regional Sales Executiveportuguese
description: About Us Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class. Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner. As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space. Job Description We are seeking a driven and results-oriented Regional Sales Executive to drive the regional sales and affiliate partnership efforts in Brazil. Reporting to the Country Manager, you will be responsible for acquiring and managing new affiliate partners, driving the region's growth, and developing strategic relationships to elevate the company’s market position. This full-time role will provide an exciting opportunity to play a pivotal role in the company's expansion while focusing on affiliate partnerships to deliver measurable business growth. Key Responsibilities: Affiliate Partner Acquisition & Management: Identify, onboard, and manage new affiliate partners, merchants, and strategic partners to expand the company’s affiliate network and drive revenue growth in Brazil. Partnership Development & Negotiation: Negotiate affiliate terms, contracts, and collaboration agreements to ensure mutually beneficial outcomes. Work closely with the marketing team to create tailored campaigns and offers that align with affiliate partners’ audiences and Bybit’s brand. Relationship Management: Maintain regular communication with affiliates, monitoring the performance of partnerships, and providing ongoing support and resources to optimize results. Foster long-term relationships with affiliates, ensuring they have the tools, incentives, and resources to succeed. Act as the main point of contact for affiliates, addressing any issues or concerns in a timely and professional manner. Affiliate Onboarding: Guide new affiliates through the onboarding process, ensuring they are equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and understanding of the company’s offerings to drive performance. Market Insights & Strategy: Conduct in-depth market research to identify emerging trends, competitive strategies, and new affiliate opportunities. Use these insights to refine outreach and acquisition strategies. Sales & Affiliate Reporting: Track and analyze key performance metrics related to affiliate performance, client acquisition, and outreach efforts. Report progress to the Country Manager and provide strategic feedback to improve future efforts. Administrative & Organizational Support: Oversee administrative tasks related to affiliate management, including record-keeping, scheduling meetings, managing communication, and preparing performance reports. Event Coordination: Assist in the planning and execution of events focused on building affiliate partnerships, such as affiliate conferences, merchant meetups, or industry workshops. Qualifications: Proven experience in sales, affiliate marketing, or business development with a focus on managing relationships and partnerships. Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to effectively pitch affiliate opportunities and build rapport with key stakeholders. Strategic mindset with a keen understanding of affiliate marketing trends, market dynamics, and how to leverage them for business success. Strong organizational skills, capable of handling multiple projects, managing time effectively, and keeping affiliate partners engaged and satisfied. Self-starter with a proactive attitude, attention to detail, and a passion for driving business results through affiliate partnerships. Why Join Us At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include: Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning. Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation. Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world. Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company. Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Seller Success Management
description: Launched in 2010, AliExpress is a global e-commerce platform dedicated to creating a better shopping experience for hundreds of millions of consumers in more than 200 countries and regions. In addition to the global English-language version, the AliExpress platform is also available in 15 other languages, including Portuguese, Spanish and French. Responsibilities: 1、Manage and cultivate relationships with local sellers, ensuring their seamless integration into the Alibaba International platform. 2、Provide technical guidance and support for sellers in integrating their systems and processes with the platform's APIs and tools. 3、Coordinate with internal teams to address sellers' technical issues, working towards swift resolutions and continuous platform improvement. 4、Develop and execute onboarding and training programs for new sellers, focusing on platform functionalities, policies, and best practices. 5、Monitor seller performance, identify areas of improvement, and implement strategies to enhance their overall platform experience and sales. 6、Stay updated on industry trends and platform updates, communicating relevant changes and enhancements to the seller community. 7、Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline seller onboarding and integration processes, reducing time-to-market and increasing efficiency. Qualifications: 1、Bachelor's degree in Administration or correlated. 2、Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in seller management or platform integration roles, preferably in e-commerce and marketplace. 3、Solid understanding of API integrations, web technologies, and e-commerce platforms. 4、Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. 5、Proven track record in managing multiple sellers and projects simultaneously, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. 6、Strong problem-solving skills, able to identify and troubleshoot technical issues effectively. 7、Fluent in the local language and English, with the ability to work in a multicultural and fast-paced environment.
